heading: One unvisited '1' = one island
body:
Scan the grid cell by cell. Each time you hit an unvisited land cell (`'1'`), you've found a **new island**. Use DFS to mark every connected land cell as visited (`'0'`), so they won't trigger another count.

- **Count** = how many DFS you start
- **DFS** marks the entire island as visited

heading: Why mark as '0' instead of visited set?
body:
Overwriting `'1'` → `'0'` in-place prevents counting the same island twice. Once DFS finishes, all cells in that island are `'0'`, so the main loop won't trigger DFS on them again.

**Bonus:** saves O(m*n) space vs. a separate visited set.

options: To prevent counting the same island multiple times
